fragments.why: DC clipping/half ties, signed horizontal/vertical/mid/diagonal impulses, three mixed spectra and two wide-quantizer arithmetic boundaries. Numeric controls, not additional images/settings.

nativeScalarDifference.reason: Signed row saturation and word-width addition of column bias. The target is the pinned normal x64 AVX path, even with managed intrinsics disabled. Scalar native agreement is claimed only where observed; no relaxed sample tolerance.

privateInverseTransform.algorithm: Generate the Q14 cosine kernel from T.81, with the pinned unit-rotation policy. Dequantized AC narrows modulo16bits; DC saturates after the1024 level shift. DC-only rows use the exact word shift; other rows round at11bits and saturate. Add the32 column bias in signed words, accumulate modulo32bits, shift20 and clip. Matrix evaluation is independent of upstream butterfly/assembly implementations; no upstream source/table in production.
privateInverseTransform.resources: 256 bytes of stack scratch per block, borrowed coefficient/quantizer/destination spans and a minor256-byte static kernel payload. No per-call owned heap buffers or escaping ownership. All4096 existing work units are admitted before destination mutation; refusal/cancellation preserve output, input and borrowed root. These are accounting/source properties, not measured GC B/op or CPU timing.

privateInverseColor.algorithm: Derive coefficients rationally from BT.601 Kr=299/1000, Kb=114/1000. No copied implementation table, float calibration or adjustable correction.
